profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Solerity
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 5 years of experience building and modernizing production applications across enterprise, defense, and healthcare environments. My background includes full-stack development with C#, .NET, Blazor, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, and Python, with a strong focus on backend systems, application performance, database optimization, and scalable software design.

I hold a B.S. in Computer Science and a Master of Software Engineering with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. I’m also AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, with hands-on experience developing and evaluating machine learning models and pipelines using Python, scikit-learn, pandas, and NumPy.

I’m especially interested in opportunities at the intersection of software engineering, cloud infrastructure, AI/ML, and platform engineering, where I can apply my production development experience while continuing to build scalable, intelligent systems.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
-Utilized SQL, C#, .Net, JavaScript, Kendo UI, HTML, and CSS while holding secret clearance.
-Collaborated with functional analysts to meticulously design and research Product Backlog Items, ensuring 
 adherence to business rules and requirements.
-Developed new features, created intuitive user experiences and delivered web applications to meet 
 business objectives.
-Investigated and resolved software bugs to optimize performance, ensuring a seamless and reliable user 
 experience.
-Optimized poorly designed code in the area responsible for handling the return of items to the facility, 
 which involved implementing nested business rules.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Front-End Development · Algorithms · Debugging · Grammarly · Data Structures · JavaScript · React.js · C# · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · SQL · Azure DevOps

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Developed sophisticated WPF and .Net desktop applications customized exclusively for mammogram 
 machines, ensuring a seamless and intuitive user experience.
-Led the successful migration of complex backend software responsible for microcontroller control from 
 one platform to another, providing users with unparalleled control and unlocking the machine's full  
 potential.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
-Made contributions at Bentley Systems during a six-month internship, utilizing C# and Python for 
 development tasks.
-Updated and optimized code to enhance project efficiency and functionality, showcasing a strong sense of initiative and technical expertise.
-Played a key role in identifying and resolving bugs, ensuring seamless project operation and 
 maintaining a high standard of software quality.
